function: For analyses considering support settlement loads in bridge structures, specify settlement groups within which supports settle simultaneously.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Load] tab > [Type : Settlement] > [Settlement Analysis Data] group > [Settlement Group]
usage:
Settlement Group

Group Name

Enter the name of a support settlement group.

Settlement Displacement

Enter the magnitude of the settled displacement for supports.

Node List

Enter the supports to be included in the support settlement group.

The supports can be directly entered or selected in the model.

Operations

The Add Button

Add the data entered in Group Name, Settlement Displacement and Node List in the support settlement group list.

The Modify Button

Modify the contents of a support settlement group entered in the list.

The Delete Button

Delete a support settlement group entered in the list.
